Hi Olivia and team,

Thanks again for the productive demo last week — really appreciated how specific you were about throughput and latency targets. Per our conversation, I put together a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (attached) to align stakeholders, success criteria, and a proposed evaluation cadence.

Goal for the kickoff: confirm stakeholders and run a 45-minute orientation so we can lock the MAP and the evaluation timeline (pilot -> POC -> production). Suggested agenda is attached as "kickoff_agenda_v1.pdf".

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue Oct 20, 10:00–10:45
- Wed Oct 21, 14:00–14:45

Can you confirm: (1) which slot works, (2) final list of attendees (include security/procurement if they want to be present), and (3) any additional success metrics we should bake into the MAP?

I cc'd Marcus (Solutions) and Rishi (Sales lead) so they can surface any technical or commercial constraints before we lock a time.

Attachments: Brightline_MAP_Draft_v1.docx, kickoff_agenda_v1.pdf

Thanks — look forward to getting this scheduled.

Best,

2) Confirmed attendees:
